cass.desc: the young porter with short messy dark brown hair, tired gray eyes, an olive green jacket with orange straps, gray hoodie, fingerless black gloves and a bandaged left forearm

ledger.desc: the black leather book with ornate brass corners and a brass clasp, its parchment pages glowing with crimson handwriting and red magic circles

warden.desc: the huge four-legged stone beast covered in gray rock plates with glowing molten orange cracks, curled ram horns, glowing orange eyes and a spiked stone tail

hale.desc: the older man with slicked-back gray hair, a short gray beard, pale blue eyes, a charcoal three-piece suit, red tie, black gloves and a cane with a glowing blue crystal handle

auditor.desc: the tall faceless figure in a long black coat and wide-brimmed black hat, wearing a smooth white mask with one vertical red line, holding a brass pocket watch

pike.desc: the blond young knight with an undercut, blue eyes, polished silver plate armor and a long royal blue cape

lise.desc: the young healer with short messy red hair, green eyes, a hooded green robe with white trim and a wooden staff with a glowing green crystal

bram.desc: the bulky archer with a shaved head, a scar across his nose, brown leather armor and a recurve bow

mara.desc: the tall young woman with a long silver-white ponytail, amber eyes, a white and gold armored long coat and a silver rapier

cass_armored.desc: the young man with short messy dark brown hair and tired gray eyes, wearing no jacket, his whole body covered in dark charcoal-brown stone armor plates with glowing molten orange cracks between them, spiked stone shoulders and back, clawed stone gauntlets and stone boots
